content:
maya: Quick sync on the autoscale veto interface for dedicated GPU pools. Need a minimal contract so control-plane can request prewarms and operator can protect packing.

cj: Important: operator needs a clear, fast response path. No hanging RPCs.

maya: Agreed. Proposal: control-plane sends Intent RPC (tenant, slots, max_cost, ttl). Operator must reply within 2s with {accepted, reason, ready_eta, cost_est}.

zhen: If operator rejects due to fragmentation, include pack_hint (preferred slot shapes) and simulated_success_pct so control-plane can retry with different shapes.

cj: Also require operator to emit metrics: prewarm_requests, prewarm_rejects, avg_ready_eta. We'll dashboard them under eng-runtime/dedicated.

maya: Rollout: start operator in log-only mode for 10 days, then advisory where control-plane shows warnings, then enforce. Feature flags for each pool.

zhen: For private installs, intents must be signed JWTs. Operator validates signature and checks nonce.

ops-bot: deploy planned: operator-canary -> infra-canary-5 at 04:20 UTC (ETA ~10m).

cj: Tests: add a sim case for MIG fragmentation where many small intents fail; assert operator returns pack_hint.

maya: OK next steps: zhen to draft proto + metrics spec by Tue; cj to add sim; i'll open rollout PR. If no objections, lock in 48h.

cj: LGTM

zhen: LGTM, starting proto now.
